errors.text_span: compares the performance of three models—mBERT, XLM-R, and same—
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies "same" as a model. The legend is titled "better", indicating that the chart shows the number of tasks where the mBERT model performed better, the XLM-R model performed better, or their performance was the "same". Therefore, "same" is an outcome category, not a model.

The description incorrectly states that the language families on the horizontal axis are listed in alphabetical order. The category "IE-other" appears after "IE-Slavic", breaking the alphabetical sequence.
The description does not mention the tick label interval for the y-axis, which is regularly spaced at an interval of 10.

errors.text_span: The approximate values for each bar are as follows: for IE-Baltic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~10, and same is ~7; for IE-Germanic, mBERT is ~4, XLM-R is ~18, and same is ~22; for IE-Indic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~5, and same is ~4; for IE-Romance, mBERT is ~4, XLM-R is ~13, and same is ~30; for IE-Slavic, mBERT is ~12, XLM-R is ~39, and same is ~28; for IE-other, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~6, and same is ~8; for Isolate, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~5, and same is ~1; for Semitic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~7, and same is ~1; and for Uralic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~14, and same is ~5.
errors.evidence: The description lists the approximate value for every single bar in the chart (27 values in total). This level of detail is excessive and harms readability. The prompt suggested describing representative values (e.g., shortest and tallest bars) instead of an exhaustive list.
